name: The Icarus Effect
source:
A small space adventure of mystery, horror, mechs, and quirkiness.

You are a herald trying to find a candidate to pilot your Gaunt, a vastly advanced organic machine, designed for the sole purpose of bringing the current war to a complete halt!

In the process you will get to know your pilot better and learn more about funny trivia and weird encounters. 

But remember, there is always darkness lurking in the back. 

[Edited from [url=https://studio-lemi.itch.io/the-icarus-effect]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一段融合謎團、恐怖、機甲與古怪元素的小小太空冒險。

你是一名使者，正在尋找Gaunt的駕駛候選人。Gaunt是一部技術遠超這個時代的有機機械，設計目的只有一個：徹底終結當前戰爭！

在此過程中，你會更加了解自己的駕駛員，也會學到有趣的冷知識和古怪的人事物。

但要記住，黑暗總潛伏在背後。

[改編自[url=https://studio-lemi.itch.io/the-icarus-effect]Itch.io[/url]]
